design.sources: 16 train, 8 historically exposed held-out; 2 steps per expert per source, source equal means
design.geometry: M256 FFN/own dynamic Q2; original full-M geometry selected-row heads with other rows synthetic zero fill
design.dtype: BF16 static factors and native activation QDQ; FP64 error reductions
design.oracle: teacher Y projected onto the fixed basis; reference, not trained student

mathematics.common_mean: Per expert mean of all train16 x2steps x256 BF16 teacherY values, in FP64; one shared mu for both bases; no per-source centering and no heldout fitting.
mathematics.PCA512: Top512 eigenvectors of exact train output covariance; fixed rank and no sweep.
mathematics.HEAD128_PCA384: Reduced QR of two step gate*centered(BF16(1+scale)*head) matrices,128 fixed columns including deterministic QR completion; append384 top complement-covariance directions and QR. Continuous head numerator preservation is measured before BF16; no native-exact claim.
mathematics.initialization: Bc0=Phi^T W2_A0, bc=Phi^T(b2_A0-mu). Output bias is mu. Freeze Phi,mu,bc,W1,b1,smooth2. Train only Bc rank32 A/B=208896 parameters/student.
mathematics.objective: Same normalized FP32 gatedY squared loss as A0; Adam256updates/student, batch256originalrows,8epochs x32source-step, lr0.0005/betas0.9,0.999/eps1e-8/no weight decay; deterministic source-step order and seed42 for fixed initialization.
mathematics.native_head: Original M31668/D5120 row-local LN/modulation/addmm geometry with true selected256 rows at original coordinates and zero synthetic other rows, not full-state replay. 96neutral+192oracle+384initial/final=672head calls.
mathematics.errors: Continuous q/sigma error decomposed into direct numerator and radial variance terms with signed cross; actual BF16 head remainder and signed remainder cross close native head SSE. Also gatedY pre-gate and real BF16 gate errors.
mathematics.deployment: Current original postQ1 -> inherited static BF16 W1+b1 -> tanhGELU -> current own6016 Smooth2/native HiF4 group64 Q2 -> BF16 Bc+bc -> BF16 Phi+mu. Three GEMMs, no middle quantizer, no online LoRA or teacherY. Q1 and Q2 remain per-call dynamic activations; new static factors are BF16, not newly quantized HiF4 weights.

inherited_A0_offline_cost.selection_and_full_A0_offline_cost: Already paid, inherited immutable support selection/calibration/recovery; parent protocol and part ledgers remain part of total lineage. No zero-cost or matched-total-offline-cost claim; parent cost not divided between the two child bases.

scope_limits: Local static MAC comparison only; no measured full-model speed, video, quality or system acceptance. Held sources historically exposed; two functions do not establish full80 behavior.
